---
title: "Overall survival by patient-level median TFx among patients with median TFx ≥ 3%"
output: html_document
date: "2026-07-01"
---
# ============================================================
# Kaplan-Meier plot: Overall survival by patient-level median TFx
# Input file already contains:
# patient_id, median_TFx, Overall_Survival_days, Event
# ============================================================
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)

# ----------------------------
# Paths
# ----------------------------
survival_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/AURORA/Survival"

input_file <- file.path(
  survival_dir,
  "AURORA_all_patients_median_TFx_patientMedianGE3_OS_Event_clean.Earliest_Met_Diagnosis.csv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(
  survival_dir,
  "KM_median_TFx_patientMedianGE3",
  "Earliest_Met_Diagnosis"
)

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

out_png <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "OS_KM_by_patient_level_median_TFx_months_with_risktable.png"
)

out_pdf <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "OS_KM_by_patient_level_median_TFx_months_with_risktable.pdf"
)

summary_out <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "OS_KM_by_patient_level_median_TFx_summary.csv"
)

cat("Input file:\n", input_file, "\n\n")
cat("Output directory:\n", out_dir, "\n\n")

# ----------------------------
# Read data
# ----------------------------
df <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Rows in input:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Columns:\n")
print(colnames(df))

# ----------------------------
# Required columns
# ----------------------------
required_cols <- c(
  "patient_id",
  "median_TFx",
  "Overall_Survival_days",
  "Event"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(df))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Missing required columns: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# Clean and prepare data
# Keep only patients with patient-level median_TFx >= 3%
# ----------------------------
days_per_month <- 365.25 / 12

min_median_TFx_cutoff <- 3

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    patient_id = as.character(patient_id),
    median_TFx = as.numeric(median_TFx),
    Overall_Survival_days = as.numeric(Overall_Survival_days),
    OS_months = Overall_Survival_days / days_per_month,
    Event = as.numeric(Event)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(patient_id),
    !is.na(median_TFx),
    median_TFx >= min_median_TFx_cutoff,
    !is.na(OS_months),
    !is.na(Event),
    OS_months > 0
  )

cat("\nApplied patient-level median_TFx cutoff: >= ", 
    min_median_TFx_cutoff, "%\n", sep = "")
cat("Patients after median_TFx cutoff:", nrow(df), "\n")
# ----------------------------
# Median TFx split
# ----------------------------
median_tfx_cut <- median(df$median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    median_TFx_group = ifelse(
      median_TFx >= median_tfx_cut,
      "High median TFx",
      "Low median TFx"
    ),
    median_TFx_group = factor(
      median_TFx_group,
      levels = c("Low median TFx", "High median TFx")
    )
  )

cat("Median patient-level TFx cutpoint:", round(median_tfx_cut, 4), "%\n\n")

cat("Group counts:\n")
print(table(df$median_TFx_group))

cat("\nEvents by group:\n")
print(table(df$median_TFx_group, df$Event))

# ----------------------------
# Survival fit
# ----------------------------
fit <- survfit(
  Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ median_TFx_group,
  data = df
)
# ----------------------------
# Median OS from KM fit
# ----------------------------
median_os_df <- survminer::surv_median(fit) %>%
  mutate(
    median_TFx_group = gsub(
      "^median_TFx_group=",
      "",
      strata
    ),
    median_TFx_group = factor(
      median_TFx_group,
      levels = levels(df$median_TFx_group)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    median_TFx_group,
    median_survival_months = median,
    median_survival_lower_95CI = lower,
    median_survival_upper_95CI = upper
  )

cat("\nMedian OS by group from KM fit:\n")
print(median_os_df)
# ----------------------------
# Log-rank p-value calculated from data
# ----------------------------
lr <- survdiff(
  Surv(OS_months, Event) ~ median_TFx_group,
  data = df
)

p_val <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = length(lr$n) - 1)

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("p = NA")
  } else if (p < 0.001) {
    return("p < 0.001")
  } else {
    return(paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  }
}

p_label <- format_p(p_val)

annot_text <- paste0(
  "Log-rank ", p_label, "\n",
  "Median TFx cutpoint = ", round(median_tfx_cut, 2), "%"
)

cat("\nLog-rank chi-square:", lr$chisq, "\n")
cat("Log-rank p-value:", p_val, "\n")
cat("Plot annotation:\n", annot_text, "\n\n")

# ----------------------------
# KM summary table
# ----------------------------
km_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(median_TFx_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_patients = n(),
    n_events_deaths = sum(Event == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_censored = sum(Event == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_TFx_within_group = median(median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_TFx_within_group = min(median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_TFx_within_group = max(median_TFx, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    median_os_df,
    by = "median_TFx_group"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    overall_median_TFx_cutpoint = median_tfx_cut,
    logrank_chi_square = lr$chisq,
    logrank_p_value = p_val
  )

write_csv(km_summary, summary_out)

cat("KM summary with median OS saved:\n", summary_out, "\n")
print(km_summary)

# ----------------------------
# Dynamic x-axis
# ----------------------------
max_month <- max(df$OS_months, na.rm = TRUE)

# Round up to nearest 60 months
x_max <- ceiling(max_month / 60) * 60

# Larger interval to avoid merged x-axis labels
break_by <- 60

# Annotation position
annot_x <- x_max * 0.96
annot_y <- 0.97

cat("\nMax OS month:", max_month, "\n")
cat("x-axis max:", x_max, "\n")
cat("x-axis interval:", break_by, "months\n")

# ----------------------------
# Legend labels
# ----------------------------
low_n <- sum(df$median_TFx_group == "Low median TFx")
low_events <- sum(
  df$median_TFx_group == "Low median TFx" &
    df$Event == 1
)

high_n <- sum(df$median_TFx_group == "High median TFx")
high_events <- sum(
  df$median_TFx_group == "High median TFx" &
    df$Event == 1
)

legend_labs <- c(
  paste0("Low median TFx (n=", low_n, ", deaths=", low_events, ")"),
  paste0("High median TFx (n=", high_n, ", deaths=", high_events, ")")
)

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------
p <- ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data = df,
  
  # Main KM curve
  conf.int = TRUE,
  conf.int.alpha = 0.22,
  censor = TRUE,
  censor.shape = 3,
  censor.size = 3.2,
  size = 1.15,
  
  # Single bottom table only
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.title = "Number at risk",
  risk.table.height = 0.24,
  risk.table.y.text = TRUE,
  risk.table.y.text.col = TRUE,
  tables.theme = theme_cleantable(base_size = 12),
  
  # Labels
  title = "Overall survival by patient-level median TFx",
  xlab = "Time from primary diagnosis (months)",
  ylab = "Overall survival probability",
  
  # Axis
  break.time.by = break_by,
  xlim = c(0, x_max),
  ylim = c(0, 1.05),
  
  # Legend
  legend.title = "Median TFx group",
  legend.labs = legend_labs,
  legend = "top",
  
  # Colors
  palette = c("#1E88E5", "#E74C3C"),
  
  # Manual p-value annotation added below
  pval = FALSE,
  
  # Style
  ggtheme = theme_classic(base_size = 15)
)

# ----------------------------
# Clean main KM plot
# ----------------------------
p$plot <- p$plot +
  annotate(
    "label",
    x = annot_x,
    y = annot_y,
    label = annot_text,
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 4.4,
    label.size = 0.25,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 18,
      margin = margin(t = 10, b = 18)
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.box.margin = margin(b = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    
    # No grid lines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 18, r = 15, b = 5, l = 15)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Clean bottom number-at-risk table
# Do not set axis.text.y because survminer uses colored y labels
# ----------------------------
p$table <- p$table +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    
    # No grid lines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 15, b = 8, l = 15)
  )

# ----------------------------
# Save outputs
# ----------------------------
png(
  filename = out_png,
  width = 12.5,
  height = 8.3,
  units = "in",
  res = 300
)
print(p)
dev.off()

pdf(
  file = out_pdf,
  width = 12.5,
  height = 8.3
)
print(p)
dev.off()

cat("\nSaved OS KM plot:\n")
cat(out_png, "\n")
cat(out_pdf, "\n")

cat("\nSaved summary table:\n")
cat(summary_out, "\n")
```
